import ast,subprocess,os,json
from pathlib import Path
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
source=Path('/Users/danielking/projects/vail/hail/hail/python/test/hail/methods/test_impex.py')
suite=source.parents[1]
cls=next(x for x in ast.parse(source.read_text()).body if isinstance(x,ast.ClassDef) and x.name=='PLINKTests')
out=Path('vail/conformance/runs/20261021-imports/integration/plink');out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
def run(n):
 name=n.name;cmd=['/Users/danielking/projects/vail/vail/.venv/bin/python','vail/conformance/full_hail_bodies.py','--suite',str(suite),'--output',str(out/(name+'.json')),'--worker-source',str(source),'--worker-name','PLINKTests.'+name]
 try:
  with (out/(name+'.log')).open('w') as log:subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=log,timeout=120)
  r=json.loads((out/(name+'.json')).read_text());print(name,r['status'],[v.get('error','')[:150] for v in r['variants']],flush=True)
 except Exception as e:print(name,str(e),flush=True)
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:list(pool.map(run,[x for x in cls.body if isinstance(x,ast.FunctionDef) and x.name.startswith('test_')]))
